readme:
# Clutch.co Scraper - B2B Agency Directory

Scrape company profiles from [Clutch.co](https://clutch.co), the leading B2B reviews and ratings platform. Extract ratings, reviews, pricing, services, and contact details for IT agencies, marketing firms, and development companies.

## Features

- **SERP scraping**: Extract agency listings from any Clutch.co directory page
- **Profile details**: Optionally fetch full profile pages for rich data (description, website, tagline, industries, client breakdown)
- **JSON-LD + HTML parsing**: Combines structured data with HTML scraping for maximum data coverage
- **Cloudflare bypass**: Uses TLS fingerprinting (Chrome 124 profile) to handle Cloudflare protection
- **Deduplication**: Automatically deduplicates agencies across pages and URLs
- **Pagination**: Follows pagination automatically up to your maxResults limit

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/clutch-co-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `clutch-co-scraper` to scrape company data from clutch co. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `searchUrls` | string[] | Clutch.co directory URLs to scrape | `["https://clutch.co/developers"]` |
| `maxResults` | integer | Maximum agencies to scrape | `100` |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | Fetch full profile pages | `true` |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | Apify proxy settings | `{"useApifyProxy": true}` |

### Example Search URLs

- `https://clutch.co/developers` - Software development companies
- `https://clutch.co/agencies/digital-marketing` - Digital marketing agencies
- `https://clutch.co/web-developers` - Web development companies
- `https://clutch.co/it-services/managed-service-providers` - Managed service providers
- `https://clutch.co/agencies/seo` - SEO agencies
- `https://clutch.co/developers/artificial-intelligence` - AI development companies

## Output

Each result contains:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` | Clutch company ID |
| `name` | Company name |
| `tagline` | Company tagline/slogan |
| `description` | Full company description |
| `website` | Company website URL |
| `phone` | Phone number |
| `email` | Email address (when available) |
| `address` | Street address |
| `city` | City |
| `country` | Country name |
| `logo_url` | Company logo image URL |
| `rating` | Clutch rating (0-5) |
| `review_count` | Number of verified reviews |
| `min_project_size` | Minimum project budget |
| `hourly_rate` | Average hourly rate range |
| `employee_count` | Employee count range |
| `founded_year` | Year the company was founded |
| `services` | List of services offered |
| `industries_served` | Industries the company serves |
| `clients` | Client size breakdown |
| `clutch_rank` | Position in the directory listing |
| `verified` | Whether the company is Clutch verified |
| `source_url` | Clutch profile URL |
| `source_platform` | Always "clutch.co" |
| `scraped_at` | ISO 8601 timestamp |

## Pricing

- **SERP result**: $0.003 per agency (listing data only)
- **Detail result**: $0.005 per agency (with full profile data)
